title: Calculate Item Subtotal & Discount
subtitle: Variables & Arithmetic
description: Declare variables for <hlt>unit_price</hlt>, <hlt>quantity</hlt>, and <hlt>discount</hlt>. Compute the final bill and run the loop to inspect values in memory.
starter_code:
# Lesson 2: Variables & Step-by-Step Execution
# Click the gutter to set breakpoints, then click "Debug" or "Step"

item_name = "Quantum Battery"
unit_price = 45.50
quantity = 3

subtotal = unit_price * quantity
discount = 10.00
total_price = subtotal - discount

print(f"Purchased: {quantity}x {item_name}")
print(f"Total Bill: ${total_price:.2f}")

# Loop example to observe variable changes
for step in range(1, 4):
    bonus = step * 5
    print(f"Step {step}: bonus = {bonus}")
intended_output:
Purchased: 3x Quantum Battery
Total Bill: $126.50
Step 1: bonus = 5
Step 2: bonus = 10
Step 3: bonus = 15
